item.title: Do cats really hate aluminium foil? What makes them startle and what science says
item.description: Aluminium foil can startle cats into avoiding countertops, but the reaction has less to do with fear and more with sensory overload. Veterinarians say the foil’s high-frequency crinkle, unfamiliar texture and reflective surface can overwhelm cats’ finely tuned hearing and instincts. The effect, however, is usually temporary, as most cats adapt once the novwelty fades.

item.title: 'Operation Hawkeye Strike': US carries out 'large-scale' airstrikes on Syria; targets ISIS
item.description: US and allied forces launched significant strikes across Syria targeting Islamic State positions. This decisive action, dubbed Operation Hawkeye Strike, serves as a direct retaliation for a recent deadly attack in Palmyra that claimed the lives of two American soldiers and a US civilian interpreter. CENTCOM vowed to pursue those responsible, emphasizing a zero-tolerance policy for attacks on their personnel.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Did someone get shot during Konvy’s livestream? Adin Ross shares update after alleged video of gunshots goes viral
item.description: A shocking clip of streamer Steven Konvy went viral after gunshots were heard. Kick ambassador Adin Ross confirmed a person named JJ was shot and hospitalized. Ross stated JJ is alive and receiving medical care. He urged viewers to pray for JJ's recovery. Konvy has not yet commented on the incident.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: IShowSpeed’s lively Africa livestreams spark a welcome change amongst fans as viral tour negates long-standing stereotypes
item.description: IShowSpeed’s South Africa tour did more than entertain fans. Through unfiltered livestreams, he showed a welcoming, vibrant side of the country that challenged long-held American stereotypes. Speed also hit his long-time goal of 47 million subscribers while being embraced by local fans.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: YouTuber KSI praises Bollywood icon Shah Rukh Khan, calls him a ‘King’
item.description: British YouTuber and boxer KSI has openly declared his admiration for Bollywood icon Shah Rukh Khan, calling him a "King" and an "absolute icon." This high praise from a global digital star highlights Khan's enduring legacy and widespread influence, transcending industries and borders. KSI expressed a desire to meet the legendary actor, underscoring Khan's continued relevance.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: DJ Sbu credits Nota Baloyi for iShowSpeed’s viral South Africa tour
item.description: South African entrepreneur DJ Sbu credited Nota Baloyi with making iShowSpeed viral during his recent South African tour. Baloyi, who acted as MC, guide, and organizer, claims he bridged the gap between the streamer and local audiences, including older generations. The tour generated significant viewership, sparking debate about cultural collaboration versus clout-chasing.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Man found with 100 human skulls and mummfied bodies in Pennsylvania grave robbery case
item.description: A man was arrested near Philadelphia's Mount Moriah Cemetery with approximately 100 human skulls and other body parts, linked to weeks of grave robberies. Investigators found extensive remains, including torsos and mummified limbs, at the suspect's home and a storage unit. The motive for the desecration of the historic burial ground remains under investigation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US shields Venezuelan oil revenue as Trump signs executive order for investment in the nation’s oil sector
item.description: US President Donald Trump has signed an executive order declaring a national emergency to safeguard Venezuelan oil revenue held in US accounts. This move aims to block creditors from seizing these funds, ensuring they are preserved for US foreign policy objectives and to promote stability in Venezuela. The order also prohibits transfers of these sovereign funds, superseding prior regulations.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: War veteran, MAGA supporter and have Filipina wife? Here's what we know about ICE agent Jonathan Ross who killed a woman in Minneapolis
item.description: ICE officer Jonathan Ross fatally shot Renee Nicole Good during a confrontation in Minneapolis. Trump administration officials defended Ross, claiming Good attempted to run him over, but witnesses dispute this. Ross, a decorated war veteran and former Border Patrol agent, is described by his father as a committed Christian and conservative.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Syria clashes: Security forces deploy in Aleppo; dozens killed in fighting
item.description: Syrian security forces deployed in Aleppo's Sheikh Maqsoud after days of clashes with Kurdish fighters, which resulted in dozens of casualties and displacement. An explosive drone later struck a government building, with state TV blaming Kurdish forces, a claim they deny. Military operations have reportedly halted, with Kurdish fighters being transferred out of the area.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Barron Trump reportedly ‘focused’ on losing his Slovenian accent to ‘be more confident’
item.description: Barron Trump, now 19 and an NYU sophomore, is quietly taking elocution lessons to refine his speech and build confidence, according to family sources. Raised multilingual under Melania Trump’s close watch, his accent reflects his upbringing. The effort isn’t about fame, but privacy, self-definition, and preparing for a future where every word may be scrutinized.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Reza Pahlavi: Why protests in Iran have revived a royal question
item.description: Reza Pahlavi was born into a future designed around continuity. Born in Tehran in 1960, he was raised as heir to the Peacock Throne, educated by private tutors, and trained for a role that assumed permanence. The monarchy was not merely a form of government. It was the organising principle of the state.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Isn't Russia already America's neighbour? The geography behind Trump's 'don't want China or Moscow as neighbour' remark
item.description: President Trump's assertion that the US must "conquer" Greenland to prevent Russian or Chinese proximity overlooks the existing maritime border with Russia. Separated by the Bering Strait, the US and Russia are just 2.4 miles apart at their closest point, with the Diomede Islands marking the divide.

item.title: ‘Happy Trump’: Trump wears own lapel pin for meeting on Venezuelan oil
item.description: President Trump wore a 'Happy Trump' lapel pin during a White House meeting with oil executives to discuss Venezuelan oil strategy. The pin, a cartoon-style depiction of himself, drew attention amidst serious geopolitical discussions. Officials stated the meeting focused on practical issues regarding potential US energy company involvement in Venezuela's oil future.

item.title: Renee Nicole Good shooting: ICE agent threatens Minneapolis women on camera, says 'don't make a bad decision'
item.description: Minneapolis women were filmed taunting ICE agents days after a protester's fatal shooting. Footage shows agents warning the women against interference, with one responding defiantly. The incident occurred amid controversy over the shooting of Renee Nicole Good, with differing accounts from ICE and local officials.
